title: dortmanna pusilla
intro: Dortmanna pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf Alder Buckthorn, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to help with digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dortmanna pusilla include its use as a laxative and an anti-inflammatory agent, due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
